Izuku was born Quirkless: a doctor confirmed it when he was a small child, from an extra joint in his little toe. The apology in Inko's record followed soon after, when he asked her whether he could still be a hero. For years everyone around them, Katsuki Bakugo included, took him for Quirkless, and so did Inko.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"His power is One For All, a stockpiling Quirk that passes from holder to holder; All Might gave it to him on the morning of the entrance exam. The ten months of dawn training she saw were All Might's plan: Izuku cleared Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of junk to build a body that could hold the power. Izuku keeps all of this from her, as from everyone, to guard All Might's secret. She has only the public version, a strong Quirk that came late, and she does not connect it to All Might.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She learns the truth only if the story has Izuku or All Might tell her. Until then her worry runs on what she can see: a son who comes home bruised, plays down his injuries and changes the subject when she asks about his Quirk.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf96\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[659,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Rei Todoroki\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf97\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Touya Todoroki, Rei's eldest, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. He was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might and inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, blue flames that his body, built more like Rei's, could not withstand. Endeavor stopped training him when the flames kept burning him and turned to Shoto; Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki; he later took the name Dabi; whether he joins the League is the story's to play. Purple burn scars are stapled to the healthy skin he has left, he dyes his white hair black, and his blue flames burn him as they burn others. He hates Endeavor above all, means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost the family, and resents Shoto as the child who replaced him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Rei suspects nothing.
